resolution: whole seconds, event-driven archive; no interpolation, no manufactured sub-second state

Q1_movement_before_purchase.question: does L5 add when an outcome falls, rises, holds, or when depth changes? Compared with archived seconds in the same windows where he did not trade.

ALL.downward_skew_definition: share(move<0) - share(move>0) over the L seconds ending at the last causally available observation; positive means the touch more often FELL into the fill than rose

RESTING_BID_CONSISTENT.downward_skew_definition: share(move<0) - share(move>0) over the L seconds ending at the last causally available observation; positive means the touch more often FELL into the fill than rose

MINT_CONSISTENT.downward_skew_definition: share(move<0) - share(move>0) over the L seconds ending at the last causally available observation; positive means the touch more often FELL into the fill than rose

Q3_does_he_reprice_with_the_market.question: does his executed price move with the BBO?

Q4_minimum_latent_ladder_INFERRED.question: does he appear to maintain multiple resting levels?
Q4_minimum_latent_ladder_INFERRED.label: INFERENCE from executions only. Unfilled and cancelled orders are unobservable, so these are LOWER BOUNDS on the number of levels, never the ladder itself.

latent_resting_evidence.caveat: size at a price is not ownership, and absence of size is not proof he had no order there

Q5_when_does_the_opposite_side_start.question: when does the opposite outcome begin filling?

pair_sum_bids_at_first_vs_at_opposite.compression_test: if two-sided acquisition needed the two touches to compress toward par, pair_sum should be materially higher at the opposite fill than at the first

Q6_sizing_vs_inventory.question: how does sizing react to inventory, holding the book comparable?

Q7_what_precedes_stopping_a_side.question: what is observable when a side stops being added to?
Q7_what_precedes_stopping_a_side.no_cancellation_inferred: the archive cannot show a cancel. These are the conditions AT the last observed fill on a side, not evidence that an order was pulled.
